sceneHint: SMALL NOTES · ACTIVE IDEAS · NEXT BUILDS

notes.label: turn the EMG model into an explorable exhibit
notes.copy: Prepare a web-ready model, useful viewpoints, and a clear fallback so the prototype can be understood without slowing down the room.
notes.detail: Show how it is assembled, not only what it looks like.

notes.label: prototype a small Lab Guide
notes.copy: Let visitors ask about the public work already inside Lab 17, with answers grounded in an approved portfolio knowledge base.
notes.detail: A guide to the room—not a general chatbot.

notes.label: separate approved facts from working notes
notes.copy: Keep the future guide aligned with confirmed public content while unfinished ideas remain clearly provisional.
notes.detail: Publish what is verified; keep drafts in the lab.

notes.label: add a quiet feedback loop
notes.copy: Learn which objects visitors explore and where the experience becomes unclear, without turning the portfolio into a tracking dashboard.
notes.detail: Collect only what can improve the visit.

notes.label: make Lab Log updates easier to publish
notes.copy: Start with a small editorial flow for dated lab notes before considering a larger content system.
notes.detail: One useful publishing path before a full CMS.

notes.label: polish the room one object at a time
notes.copy: Refine framing, scale, lighting, hover states, and touch targets across desktop and mobile.
notes.detail: Keep the atmosphere; remove the friction.

notes.label: walk the whole room before release
notes.copy: Check content, accessibility, performance, and the complete exploration path in a controlled preview.
notes.detail: Release readiness is a checkpoint, not a date.
